title: NIST WebBook: Phosphoric Acid is H3O4P, molecular weight 97.9952 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Phosphoric Acid as H3O4P, molecular weight 97.9952 amu, CAS 7664-38-2.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Phosphoric Acid, CAS Registry Number 7664-38-2, lists molecular formula H3O4P and molecular weight 97.9952 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 97.97689520 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/H3O4P/c1-5(2,3)4/h(H3,1,2,3,4). The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
